screen30-a1.description: dark full-width button "GO TO SET" in the permission dialog
screen30-a1.visible_text: "GO TO SET", under "Request permission to access all files" and its explanation
screen30-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label repeats the visible words; not used in the verdict
screen30-a1.initial_rationale: "GO TO SET" is not a phrase — "SET" could be settings, a setting, or setting something; it does not say that the user will leave the app for a system page, and the dialog offers no other way out
screen30-a1.deciding_evidence: the button does open system settings, but "GO TO SET" only makes sense once you have seen where it goes — the words themselves do not name the destination — tested once on screen14-a1; this is a duplicate of that control and the verdict is carried here
screen30-a1.recommendation: relabel it "Open Settings to allow access" (or "Go to Settings"), and add a "Not now" option
